<#if execution.resultStatus == "ERRORED" || execution.resultStatus == "SUCCESSFUL" || execution.resultStatus == "WARNING">
{
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*${tenant}: ${policy.name}* Execution succeed"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "divider"
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Start Time:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.startedAt)}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*End Time:* ${acceldata_dateFormat(execution.finishedAt)}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Result Status:* ${execution.resultStatus}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Warning Rows:* ${result.warningRows}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Failed Rows:* ${result.failedRows}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Total Rows:* ${result.rows}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Quality Score:* ${result.qualityScore}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Rules Passed:* ${result.successCount}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Rules Failed:* ${result.failureCount}"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "divider"
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Impacted Assets:*"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "divider"
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "To Check the Execution Details"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "actions",
      "elements": [
        {
          "type": "button",
          "text": {
            "type": "plain_text",
            "text": "Click Here",
            "emoji": true
          },
          "value": "click_me_123",
          "url": "${execution.link}"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "divider"
    }
  ]
}
</#if>
